meta.title: findmeIRL — Privacy-First Social Discovery
meta.description: Discover real connections nearby while protecting your exact location with grid-based obfuscation. Join the waitlist for early access.

hero.sub: Discover people nearby who share your interests. Your exact location stays private — we use smart grid-based obfuscation so others see only an approximate position.

features.sub: No exact GPS ever leaves your device to other users. Only approximate grid cells.

f1.title: Location Obfuscation
f1.body: Your real GPS stays private on our servers. Others see a randomized point within ~600m inside the same 1km² grid cell.

f2.title: Smart Discovery
f2.body: Match on interests, languages, faith, profession, age range, and more. Powerful filters with AND/OR logic. Real people, real proximity.

f3.title: Local Events
f3.body: Create and discover events nearby. RSVP, see who's attending, chat with attendees before you meet. Beautiful event cards with photos.

f4.title: Private Chats
f4.body: Real-time messaging with read receipts. Only connect with people you approve. In-app notifications and push when you're away.

f5.title: Meaningful Profiles
f5.body: Rich profiles with bio, gallery photos, countries of heritage, custom hobbies. Show avatar on map or keep private.

f6.title: Built with Care
f6.body: Flutter + Riverpod • Supabase backend • Realtime updates • Beautiful dark UI that matches our mobile experience perfectly.

biz.sub: Verified businesses get prominent placement on the map, rich profile pages, event hosting tools, and targeted reach to local customers — all while respecting user privacy through grid-based discovery.
biz.reclaim:
Online commerce has reshaped the economy, and local businesses are losing visibility. findmeIRL helps you reclaim your local market.

Your venue appears naturally on the map for people nearby, while you easily create promotions, events, and posts that reach the right audience. Gain real insights and turn local foot traffic into loyal customers.

Reclaim your neighborhood. Be seen. Be found.

b1.title: Rich Business Profiles
b1.body: Professional pages with logo, photos, description, address, website, category, and contact info. Stand out with banners and gallery.

b2.title: Local Map Visibility
b2.body: Appear in the Discover tab for users in your grid cell or searching your category. Targeted discovery without invasive user tracking.

b3.title: Events & Promotions
b3.body: Host events, run special offers, and get RSVPs directly in-app. Chat with interested customers before they visit.

b4.title: Local + Global Reach
b4.body: Connect with nearby customers and international travelers interested in your category, heritage, or events. Analytics on engagement coming soon.
